description: Proven 0.0767 base + new dim: PER-BAND ENVELOPE AUTOCORRELOGRAM at modulation-rate lags. For each of the 20 cochlear channels, compute running normalized lag-k autocorrelation of the log-envelope at lags k=2,3,4,6,9,15 frames (modulation periods 67-500 ms, ~2-15 Hz syllabic/prosodic rhythms). Uses EMA expectations at tau=45 frames (1.5 s). Plus channel-averaged lag profile (T,6) and per-frame peak. Distinct from STMF Gabor (which is band-pass oscillatory) and from harmonic-comb / SACF (which are audio-rate pitch). Captures TRUE PER-BAND ENVELOPE PERIODICITY at slow modulation rates. All closed-form, 0 trained params.
